# New Module Scaffolder — Evently Modular Monolith

You are an expert .NET modular monolith architect. You scaffold entirely new domain modules following
the exact structure, conventions, and wiring established in existing modules (Events, Users, Ticketing, Attendance).

## CONTEXT — Read These Files First

Before generating ANY code, deeply study the existing Events module as the canonical reference:

- `src/Modules/Events/Evently.Modules.Events.Domain/` — entity, repository interface, errors, domain events, value objects
- `src/Modules/Events/Evently.Modules.Events.Application/` — commands, queries, handlers, validators, abstractions (IUnitOfWork)
- `src/Modules/Events/Evently.Modules.Events.Infrastructure/` — DbContext, repository impl, module registration, Outbox/Inbox config
- `src/Modules/Events/Evently.Modules.Events.Presentation/` — endpoints, integration event handlers, Permissions, Tags
- `src/Modules/Events/Evently.Modules.Events.IntegrationEvents/` — shared event contracts
- `src/Modules/Events/Evently.Modules.Events.PublicApi/` — synchronous cross-module query contracts
- `src/Modules/Events/Evently.Modules.Events.Infrastructure/Database/Schemas.cs` — schema constant
- `src/Modules/Events/Evently.Modules.Events.Infrastructure/Database/EventsDbContext.cs` — DbContext pattern
- `src/Modules/Events/Evently.Modules.Events.Infrastructure/EventsModule.cs` — full DI registration
- `src/API/Evently.Api/Program.cs` — module registration in API host

Also read:
- `Directory.Build.props` — shared MSBuild properties
- `Evently.sln` — solution structure

## KEY FILE TEMPLATES

### Schemas.cs
```csharp
namespace Evently.Modules.{Module}.Infrastructure.Database;

internal static class Schemas
{
    internal const string {Module} = "{module_lowercase}";
}
```

### DbContext
```csharp
using Evently.Modules.{Module}.Application.Abstractions.Data;
using Evently.Modules.{Module}.Domain.{Aggregate};
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Evently.Modules.{Module}.Infrastructure.Database;

public sealed class {Module}DbContext(DbContextOptions<{Module}DbContext> options)
    : DbContext(options), IUnitOfWork
{
    internal DbSet<{Aggregate}> {Aggregate}s { get; init; }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        modelBuilder.HasDefaultSchema(Schemas.{Module});
        modelBuilder.ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly(typeof({Module}DbContext).Assembly);
    }
}
```

```csharp

}
```

```csharp
        // 5. Inbox options + job
    }

    private static void AddApplication(this IServiceCollection services)
    {
        // 1. AddApplicationFromAssembly
        // 2. Scan + register domain event handlers
        // 3. Decorate with IdempotentDomainEventHandler<>
    }

    private static void AddPresentation(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        // 1. AddEndpointsFromAssembly
        // 2. AddMassTransit — scan integration event handlers, register consumers
        // 3. Scan + register integration event handlers
        // 4. Decorate with IdempotentIntegrationEventHandler<>
    }
}
```

### ConfigureProcessOutboxJob.cs
```csharp
using Evently.Common.Infrastructure.Outbox;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Quartz;

namespace Evently.Modules.{Module}.Infrastructure.Outbox;

internal sealed class ConfigureProcessOutboxJob(IOptions<OutboxOptions> outboxOptions)
    : IConfigureOptions<QuartzOptions>
{
    private readonly OutboxOptions _outboxOptions = outboxOptions.Value;

    public void Configure(QuartzOptions options)
    {
        string jobName = typeof(ProcessOutboxJob<>)
            .MakeGenericType(typeof(Database.{Module}DbContext))
            .FullName!;

        options.AddJob<ProcessOutboxJob<Database.{Module}DbContext>>(configure => configure.WithIdentity(jobName))
            .AddTrigger(configure =>
                configure
                    .ForJob(jobName)
                    .WithSimpleSchedule(schedule =>
                        schedule.WithIntervalInSeconds(_outboxOptions.IntervalInSeconds).RepeatForever()));
    }
}
```

### ConfigureProcessInboxJob.cs — Same pattern with `ProcessInboxJob<>` and `InboxOptions`.

## API HOST REGISTRATION

Add to `src/API/Evently.Api/Program.cs` (or `Evently.Ticketing.Api/Program.cs` depending on deployment target):

```csharp
// In service registration section:
builder.Services.Add{Module}Module(builder.Configuration);

// The module's endpoints are auto-discovered via AddEndpointsFromAssembly + MapEndpoints
```

## CONFIGURATION FILES

Add module config to the API host's config:

### `modules.{module_lowercase}.json`
```json
{
  "{Module}": {
    "Outbox": {
      "IntervalInSeconds": 10,
      "BatchSize": 20
    },
    "Inbox": {
      "IntervalInSeconds": 10,
      "BatchSize": 20
    }
  }
}
```

### `modules.{module_lowercase}.Development.json`
```json
{
}
```

Register in `Program.cs`:
```csharp
builder.Configuration.AddModuleConfiguration(["events", "users", "attendance", "{module_lowercase}"]);
```

Add all six new projects to `Evently.sln` under the appropriate solution folder.

## CHECKLIST — Before Completing

- [ ] All 6 projects created with correct `.csproj` references
- [ ] Domain entity with factory method returning `Result<T>`, private setters, domain events
- [ ] `{Aggregate}Errors` with `NotFound` method and business rule errors
- [ ] Repository interface in Domain, implementation in Infrastructure
- [ ] `IUnitOfWork` and `IDbConnectionFactory` in Application Abstractions
- [ ] DbContext with schema, entity configuration, `IUnitOfWork` implementation
- [ ] `Schemas.cs` with lowercase schema name
- [ ] `{Module}Module.cs` with full DI registration (Application + Infrastructure + Presentation)
- [ ] Outbox/Inbox job configuration classes
- [ ] At least one Command slice and one Query slice
- [ ] Endpoints with full OpenAPI metadata
- [ ] `Permissions.cs` and `Tags.cs` in Presentation
- [ ] Module configuration JSON files
- [ ] Module registered in API host `Program.cs`
- [ ] Projects added to `.sln`
- [ ] All classes follow `sealed`, `internal` conventions
- [ ] Snake_case DB naming via `UseSnakeCaseNamingConvention()`
